description.narrative: (Ghana): The activity is designed to reach its goal through the extensive and intensive training of 27 local civil society organizations spread throughout the country on district budgeting and capital project procurement processes. Citizens' knowledge about lawful procurement processes at the district level equips them with skills to identify circumvented procedural requirements. Secondly performance audits, conducted on district capital projects, generate data which is converted into user-friendly scorecards for citizens to use to hold district officials accountable. Thirdly, via extensive civil society monitoring of capital projects under construction and public information campaigns, citizens are able to use monitoring data to demand improved contractor performance and accountability.
